summary: Driver/delivery module tested end-to-end (backend pytest 13/14 + edge-case probes, WS realtime, UI flows on 390x844 web preview). Core flow works: dispatch offer over WS -> offer sheet with 30s ring -> accept -> live driver_loc to customer -> steps -> OTP proof (wrong OTP 400 shown in modal) -> delivered -> customer rating; chat both ways, earnings/payout min 50, trips, profile (veh/doc/nav testIDs), driver-apply, merchant fleet. Found 1 CRITICAL (legacy /api/driver/orders/{oid}/deliver credits wallet repeatedly w/o OTP), 3 HIGH backend logic bugs, and 1 blocking UI bug I fixed (merchant fleet map had 0px height). No deprecated Expo packages detected.

critical.issue: Still live. Delivers with NO OTP/photo proof, NO status check -> calling it twice on an already-delivered order credited the wallet twice (+30 SAR verified). Also legacy /driver/orders/{oid}/accept (no approval/OTP, non-atomic) and /pickup bypass the new flow. Remove or route to delivery.py logic.

Does not check order status: after order was cancelled, accept returned 200 and flipped status cancelled -> assigned. take_order() filter only checks driver_id empty; add status:'ready_for_pickup' to the update filter. Also does not check expires_at (expired offer accepted with 200 inside the 3s expiry-loop window).
No status guard: a 'delivered' order was reset to 'ready_for_pickup' and re-dispatched (also picked up by set_online dispatch loop). Restrict to processing/confirmed/preparing.
can_view() allows any role in (merchant, chamber, employee). Chamber account 0550000000 read private customer-driver chat (200). Spec: only owner customer, assigned driver, merchant.

minor.issue: Allows assigning to a pending/rejected (unapproved) driver and ignores 3-active-orders cap.
Allows skipping steps (to_store -> at_customer directly) since only index ordering is checked.
Check-then-set not atomic (double submit race could double-count rating).
Any malformed JSON/float in a message hits the broad except and silently closes the socket; validate per-message instead.
'today' uses UTC midnight, not Asia/Riyadh (+3) -> trips 00:00-03:00 local counted in previous day.
access-control-allow-origin: * together with allow-credentials: true (even for Origin evil.example.com). Use explicit origins.
Backend error details are Arabic-only (e.g. 'رمز التسليم غير صحيح', 'الحد الأدنى للسحب') and show untranslated in English UI.

ui_bugs.issue: track style has justifyContent:'center' so the knob starts in the MIDDLE of the pill covering the label ('Slide t[knob]onnect', 'Swipe: [knob]r Order'); on native the swipe range (w-KNOB-8) from center pushes the knob out of the track. Use justifyContent:'flex-start' (RTL aware).
FIXED by tester: style {height:260, flex:0} became 'flex: 0 1 0%' on web -> map height 0 (hidden). Changed to flexGrow:0, flexShrink:0, flexBasis:'auto'; verified 260px with markers.

First time opening chat from track-order and sending, the customer's own message was saved (DB) but not rendered; appeared after reload. Driver side rendered fine. Likely race between initial load() GET and optimistic append. Retest.
Map still shows the old driver->store route line and driver marker after status delivered; no thank-you state after rating (rate box just disappears).

design_issues.screen: Driver Map/Offer/Active/Earnings/Profile, Chat, Driver Apply (English mode)
issues: Many strings stay Arabic in English UI: offer sheet 'طلب توصيل جديد', 'ربحك', 'مسافة التوصيل', 'كاش', swipe labels 'اسحب لقبول الطلب'/'اسحب: وصلت للمتجر', action labels 'ملاحة/محادثة/مشكلة' (first render), earnings header/labels, profile 'المستندات', 'تطبيق الملاحة المفضل', 'آخر التقييمات', 'ارفع', driver-apply header/subtitle and success text
Arabic text renders with disconnected letters in the web preview (e.g. 'ا س ح ب', chat chips) - check for letterSpacing on Text styles; verify on device
Merchant fleet header says 'Direct Fleet' (translation of البث/الأسطول) while menu says 'Live Fleet'

action_items: CRITICAL: remove/disable legacy server.py /api/driver/orders/{oid}/accept|pickup|deliver (deliver gives repeat wallet credits without OTP).
take_order(): add status 'ready_for_pickup' (or allowed statuses for manual assign) to the atomic update filter; accept_offer: reject if expires_at < now.
mark-ready: only allow from processing/confirmed/preparing; validate ObjectId.
can_view(): drop 'chamber' (and decide on 'employee') for messages/live/WS sub.
SwipeButton: track justifyContent 'flex-start' so knob starts at edge and doesn't cover label.
Fix customer chat optimistic append race (merge GET result with existing msgs instead of replacing).
Translate remaining hardcoded Arabic strings in driver components/earnings/profile/driver-apply and backend error details; check Arabic letterSpacing.
assign: require approved driver; step: enforce sequential steps; CORS explicit origins.
Clear route/driver marker on track-order when delivered; show thank-you after rating.
critical_code_review_comments: delivery.py 800 lines (>700) - consider splitting driver/customer/merchant routers.

src/utils/live.ts singleton socket is never closed on logout (no live.close() anywhere) - after logout/login as another user on same device the socket stays authenticated as the previous user (receives their offers/chat). Call live.close() in logout.
order_live() calls OSRM on every poll per customer (4s timeout) - cache route per driver/step.
map_view reads static_map.html synchronously on every request - cache at startup.
driver-apply.tsx: j.detail may be a list (422) -> shows [object Object].

success_rate.backend: 93% (13/14 pytest; + 3 edge-case bugs and 1 critical legacy endpoint bug found)
success_rate.frontend: ~85% (all requested flows functional; swipe knob layout bug, fleet map 0-height (fixed), customer chat optimistic render miss)

seed_data_creation: Test orders (_test:true) created and deleted; 2 applicant users deleted; driver 0540001111 reset to offline, cash_in_hand 0, wallet 15, nav_app google, rating 5/1, total_deliveries 188; the 2 other originally-online drivers restored online.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Other seeded drivers are online by default and will steal dispatch offers - tests set them offline temporarily (see fixtures). Web geolocation: grant via context.grant_permissions to see online swipe; otherwise driver-perm card shows. Swipe on web = long-press '<testID>-tap' (>=350ms). Browser API latency via ingress is ~2-4s, wait accordingly. Env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL).
rca_of_issue: Fleet map: RN-web converts flex:0 to 'flex: 0 1 0%' -> basis 0 + shrink -> height 0 despite height:260. Accept-after-cancel: take_order filter only on driver_id. Repeat wallet credit: legacy deliver endpoint lacks status/driver checks beyond driver_id match.
